find: return Math.abs( below ) <= 1 && above > 1 ? 'bottom' : Math.abs( above ) <= 1 && below > 1 ? 'top' : null;
why: a block floating inside the hero, or one filling it, would be bottom-aligned
an in-flow block, which the hero's own alignment places, would be decided here
a block anchored to different sides at different widths would take the first width's side
the innermost holder of the words, not the block placed against the hero, would be judged
a hero with no words would anchor to an empty block
a split hero would be decided by its content block
a value the setting does not hold would be written
a later writer's reading of the hero's own justify-content would replace the decided side
